subject: Adjust the size of the plot

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: Adjust the size of the plot
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to create a plot that I could change its size (height and width) since the plot was generated either from one individual or all individuals which I specified in a selectInput. When the plot was made including all individuals, the whole plot was kind of squeezed to fit the size. I know in the plotOutput that i can specify the height and width. I am wondering, whether there is a way that I can make these as variables

For example in the sidePanel, I have
 numericInput('height',"Height (px)", min=400, max=1000, value=500),
  numericInput('width','Width (px)',min=400, max=1000, value=500)

In the mainPanel, plotOutput('plot1', height=input.height, width=input.width). It didn't work and error msg said couldn't find input.height or input.width. I thought in this way i could link the plotOutput to the numericInput. Any suggestion? or any other way to fix it?

Thanks.

messages.author: 5fe1ec6d5cb2a6cf
messages.subject: Re: Adjust the size of the plot
parts:
If I give huge values to height and width in renderPlot(), I have to scroll around to see the whole plot in the mainPanel. But if I give the same values to the height and width in plotOutput(), I can see the whole picture without scrolling. It seems to increase the size of the "window" on the mainPanel and plot is presented in this enlarged window. That's why I want to make height and width flexible in plotOutput() rather than renderPlot(). I want to avoid "scrolling" (may sound lazy :).

Thanks.
